# BabyRock Social

> BabyRock: your social presence, handled from WhatsApp

Instagram, Facebook, Google and your website, run from one WhatsApp thread. A restaurant's posts, a creator's DMs, a shop's offers, an artist's site. Join the waitlist.

> Join the BabyRock waitlist and we will contact you when a place opens.
